verification_guide.title: Character verification
verification_guide.description: A character can be linked to only one FullParty account at a time. Here's how the three states work.

unverified.title: Unverified
unverified.description: You've added this character from search, but ownership has not yet been verified. It stays linked to your account unless another account completes a Lodestone or XIVAuth claim. Simply adding it elsewhere cannot take it from you.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Attending three qualifying completed runs confirms this character as yours. It stays linked exclusively to your account. Another account can only take it over by completing the stronger Lodestone or XIVAuth claim process.

claimed.title: Claimed
claimed.description: You've confirmed ownership through Lodestone or XIVAuth. Claimed is the strongest status: another account cannot take the character automatically, even with new proof. Any transfer requires admin-reviewed recovery.

qualifying.title: Which runs count?
qualifying.attendance: You must actually attend a completed run. Being accepted, on standby, or marked missing does not count. Arriving late can count if you took part.
qualifying.independent: Runs you host, groups you own, and attendance you confirm yourself do not count. Attendance must be confirmed by someone with a Claimed character and an account at least 30 days old.
qualifying.timing: At most one run counts per 24 hours, with at least seven days between your first and third qualifying attendance.
qualifying.same_group: You can attend all three runs with the same group or host. Each run counts once, for the character you attended with on this account.

claim.title: How to claim your character
claim.follow_instructions: Follow the ownership verification instructions to complete your claim.
claim.direct: You can claim your character straight away. You don't need to earn Verified or complete three runs first.
